LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 13.3.1 ‘WH’ QUESTIONS (WHY, WHOM, HOW)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Language Use 13.3.1 ‘Wh’ questions (why, whom, how)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 13.3.1 ‘Wh’ questions (why, whom, how), part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: why’, ‘whom’ and ‘how’ with peers. ● Role play activities that lead 1. Why is it important to ask questions correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Listen to recorded conversations containing the Wh- questions.

2. Identify sentences containing Wh-questions. Learners with speech difficulties can identify orally, by typing or writing.

3. Engage in meaningful question and answer dialogues using of ‘why’, ‘whom’ and ‘how’ with peers.

4. Role play activities that lead 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Listen to recorded conversations containing the Wh- questions.
2. Identify sentences containing Wh-questions. Learners with speech difficulties can identify orally, by typing or writing.
3. Engage in meaningful question and answer dialogues using of ‘why’, ‘whom’ and ‘how’ with peers.
4. Role play activities that lead 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 13.3.1 ‘Wh’ questions (why, whom, how) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is enhanced as they engage in meaningful question and

answer dialogues using ‘why’, ‘whom’ and ‘how’ appropriately.

131

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively with peers to practise Wh- questions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life-skills (self-esteem) learner acquires high level enhanced self-esteem as they gain the mastery of asking questions using the

Wh- words.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner uses the Wh- questions to seek for information through asking questions in other learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital

devices
